queryLines: WITH rule_dims AS (   SELECT     check:name::string AS check_name,     CASE check:user_metadata:dimensao_r18::string WHEN '1' THEN 'I' WHEN '2' THEN 'II' WHEN '3' THEN 'III' WHEN '4' THEN 'IV' WHEN '5' THEN 'V' WHEN '6' THEN 'VI' WHEN '7' THEN 'VII' WHEN '8' THEN 'VIII' WHEN '9' THEN 'IX' WHEN '10' THEN 'X' WHEN '11' THEN 'XI' WHEN '12' THEN 'XII' ELSE check:user_metadata:dimensao_r18::string END AS dimensao_r18   FROM IDENTIFIER(:dqx_rules_schema || '.dq_quality_rules')   WHERE status = 'approved' ), dim_rules AS (   SELECT dimensao_r18, COUNT(*) AS rules_count   FROM rule_dims WHERE dimensao_r18 IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY dimensao_r18 ), latest_runs AS (   SELECT run_id, source_table_fqn, total_rows FROM (     SELECT run_id, source_table_fqn, total_rows,       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source_table_fqn ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn     FROM IDENTIFIER(:dqx_schema || '.dq_validation_runs')     WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'       AND source_table_fqn LIKE concat(:catalog, '.silver.%')   ) WHERE rn = 1 ), metrics_explode AS (   SELECT lr.total_rows AS run_total_rows, cm.check_name, cm.error_count, cm.warning_count   FROM IDENTIFIER(:dqx_schema || '.dq_metrics') m   JOIN latest_runs lr ON lr.run_id = m.run_id   LATERAL VIEW explode(     from_json(m.metric_value, 'array<struct<check_name:string,error_count:bigint,warning_count:bigint>>')   ) AS cm   WHERE m.metric_name = 'check_metrics' ), dim_metrics AS (   SELECT rd.dimensao_r18,     SUM(me.run_total_rows) AS total_rows,     SUM(COALESCE(me.error_count, 0) + COALESCE(me.warning_count, 0)) AS invalid_rows   FROM metrics_explode me   JOIN rule_dims rd ON rd.check_name = me.check_name   GROUP BY rd.dimensao_r18 ) SELECT   d.dimensao_id,   d.nome AS dimensao,   d.meta_padrao_pct AS meta_pct,   COALESCE(dr.rules_count, 0) AS rules_count,   CASE     WHEN COALESCE(dr.rules_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0.0     WHEN COALESCE(dm.total_rows, 0) = 0 THEN 100.0     ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (dm.total_rows - COALESCE(dm.invalid_rows, 0)) / dm.total_rows, 2)   END AS score_pct,   CASE     WHEN COALESCE(dr.rules_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'SEM REGRAS'     WHEN COALESCE(dm.total_rows, 0) = 0 THEN 'CONFORME'     WHEN 100.0 * (dm.total_rows - COALESCE(dm.invalid_rows, 0)) / dm.total_rows >= d.meta_padrao_pct THEN 'CONFORME'     WHEN 100.0 * (dm.total_rows - COALESCE(dm.invalid_rows, 0)) / dm.total_rows >= d.meta_padrao_pct * 0.8 THEN 'ALERTA'     ELSE 'CRITICO'   END AS status FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.reference.dimensoes_r18') d LEFT JOIN dim_rules dr ON dr.dimensao_r18 = d.dimensao_id LEFT JOIN dim_metrics dm ON dm.dimensao_r18 = d.dimensao_id ORDER BY d.dimensao_id

datasets.name: ds_dimensoes_trend
datasets.displayName: Evolução mensal de score por dimensão
queryLines: WITH rule_dims AS (   SELECT     check:name::string AS check_name,     CASE check:user_metadata:dimensao_r18::string WHEN '1' THEN 'I' WHEN '2' THEN 'II' WHEN '3' THEN 'III' WHEN '4' THEN 'IV' WHEN '5' THEN 'V' WHEN '6' THEN 'VI' WHEN '7' THEN 'VII' WHEN '8' THEN 'VIII' WHEN '9' THEN 'IX' WHEN '10' THEN 'X' WHEN '11' THEN 'XI' WHEN '12' THEN 'XII' ELSE check:user_metadata:dimensao_r18::string END AS dimensao_r18   FROM IDENTIFIER(:dqx_rules_schema || '.dq_quality_rules')   WHERE status = 'approved' ), runs_6m AS (   SELECT run_id, total_rows, date_trunc('MONTH', created_at) AS mes   FROM IDENTIFIER(:dqx_schema || '.dq_validation_runs')   WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'     AND source_table_fqn LIKE concat(:catalog, '.silver.%')     AND created_at >= add_months(current_date(), -6) ), metrics_explode AS (   SELECT r.mes, r.total_rows AS run_total_rows,     cm.check_name, cm.error_count, cm.warning_count   FROM IDENTIFIER(:dqx_schema || '.dq_metrics') m   JOIN runs_6m r ON r.run_id = m.run_id   LATERAL VIEW explode(     from_json(m.metric_value, 'array<struct<check_name:string,error_count:bigint,warning_count:bigint>>')   ) AS cm   WHERE m.metric_name = 'check_metrics' ) SELECT   me.mes,   d.dimensao_id,   d.nome AS dimensao,   CASE WHEN SUM(me.run_total_rows) = 0 THEN 100.0        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(me.run_total_rows) - SUM(COALESCE(me.error_count,0) + COALESCE(me.warning_count,0))) / SUM(me.run_total_rows), 2)   END AS score_pct FROM metrics_explode me JOIN rule_dims rd ON rd.check_name = me.check_name JOIN IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.reference.dimensoes_r18') d ON d.dimensao_id = rd.dimensao_r18 GROUP BY me.mes, d.dimensao_id, d.nome ORDER BY me.mes, d.dimensao_id

datasets.name: ds_kpi_summary
queryLines: WITH rule_dims AS (   SELECT     check:name::string AS check_name,     CASE check:user_metadata:dimensao_r18::string WHEN '1' THEN 'I' WHEN '2' THEN 'II' WHEN '3' THEN 'III' WHEN '4' THEN 'IV' WHEN '5' THEN 'V' WHEN '6' THEN 'VI' WHEN '7' THEN 'VII' WHEN '8' THEN 'VIII' WHEN '9' THEN 'IX' WHEN '10' THEN 'X' WHEN '11' THEN 'XI' WHEN '12' THEN 'XII' ELSE check:user_metadata:dimensao_r18::string END AS dimensao_r18   FROM IDENTIFIER(:dqx_rules_schema || '.dq_quality_rules')   WHERE status = 'approved' ), dim_rules AS (   SELECT dimensao_r18, COUNT(*) AS rules_count   FROM rule_dims WHERE dimensao_r18 IS NOT NULL   GROUP BY dimensao_r18 ), latest_runs AS (   SELECT run_id, total_rows FROM (     SELECT run_id, source_table_fqn, total_rows,       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY source_table_fqn ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn     FROM IDENTIFIER(:dqx_schema || '.dq_validation_runs')     WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'       AND source_table_fqn LIKE concat(:catalog, '.silver.%')   ) WHERE rn = 1 ), metrics_explode AS (   SELECT lr.total_rows AS run_total_rows, cm.check_name, cm.error_count, cm.warning_count   FROM IDENTIFIER(:dqx_schema || '.dq_metrics') m   JOIN latest_runs lr ON lr.run_id = m.run_id   LATERAL VIEW explode(     from_json(m.metric_value, 'array<struct<check_name:string,error_count:bigint,warning_count:bigint>>')   ) AS cm   WHERE m.metric_name = 'check_metrics' ), dim_metrics AS (   SELECT rd.dimensao_r18,     SUM(me.run_total_rows) AS total_rows,     SUM(COALESCE(me.error_count, 0) + COALESCE(me.warning_count, 0)) AS invalid_rows   FROM metrics_explode me   JOIN rule_dims rd ON rd.check_name = me.check_name   GROUP BY rd.dimensao_r18 ), por_dim AS (   SELECT     d.dimensao_id,     d.meta_padrao_pct AS meta_pct,     COALESCE(dr.rules_count, 0) AS rules_count,     CASE       WHEN COALESCE(dr.rules_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0.0       WHEN COALESCE(dm.total_rows, 0) = 0 THEN 100.0       ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (dm.total_rows - COALESCE(dm.invalid_rows, 0)) / dm.total_rows, 2)     END AS score_pct   FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.reference.dimensoes_r18') d   LEFT JOIN dim_rules dr ON dr.dimensao_r18 = d.dimensao_id   LEFT JOIN dim_metrics dm ON dm.dimensao_r18 = d.dimensao_id ) SELECT   ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rules_count > 0 THEN score_pct END), 2) AS score_medio,   SUM(CASE WHEN rules_count > 0 AND score_pct >= meta_pct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dims_conformes,   SUM(CASE WHEN rules_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dims_sem_regras,   COUNT(*) AS total_dims FROM por_dim

COALESCE(dm.invalid_rows, 0)) / dm.total_rows   END, 2) AS score_pct,   d.nivel_implementacao,   CASE     WHEN COALESCE(dr.rules_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'SEM REGRAS'     WHEN COALESCE(dm.total_rows, 0) = 0 THEN 'CONFORME'     WHEN 100.0 * (dm.total_rows - COALESCE(dm.invalid_rows, 0)) / dm.total_rows >= d.meta_padrao_pct THEN 'CONFORME'     WHEN 100.0 * (dm.total_rows - COALESCE(dm.invalid_rows, 0)) / dm.total_rows >= d.meta_padrao_pct * 0.8 THEN 'ALERTA'     ELSE 'CRITICO'   END AS status FROM IDENTIFIER(:catalog || '.reference.dimensoes_r18') d LEFT JOIN dim_rules dr ON dr.dimensao_r18 = d.dimensao_id LEFT JOIN dim_metrics dm ON dm.dimensao_r18 = d.dimensao_id ORDER BY d.dimensao_id
